title: fix: polish pollen price and signed-out footer
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fixes the price badge overflow by keeping the total inside the pill and rendering the fee beneath it.
- Removes the extra mobile-only bottom padding below the Buy button while preserving desktop spacing.
- Hides duplicate Terms, Privacy, and Refunds footer links for signed-out users.
- Makes the consent copy inherit the GitHub sign-in font at the existing micro size.
- Validated with Biome, the Enter frontend production build, and TypeScript.

gist.headline: The pill holds together
gist.blurb: The Pollen checkout got a small but satisfying sweep: totals now stay inside their little price pill, fees know where to stand, and the signed-out footer stopped repeating itself.
gist.summary: Polished the Enter checkout UI by keeping Pollen pack totals inside the price badge, placing fees beneath it, removing extra mobile Buy-button padding, and hiding duplicate signed-out footer links.
gist.impact: People buying Pollen will see a cleaner responsive checkout, with readable price badges, tighter mobile spacing, and one sensible set of Terms, Privacy, and Refunds links.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy checkout counter in a garden shed: Polli carefully fits glowing Pollen coins into a tidy rounded price pill while a tiny fee label sits neatly below. A retro terminal shows a clean Buy button, with duplicate footer-link slips being tucked away among flowers and code-plants.
